project_identity.domain: Productivity / AI Writing Companion (Mobile Web App)
project_identity.vibe: Approachable, tactile, optimistic, and highly distinct. Breaking the sterile 'SaaS' look of typical AI tools by using Neo-Brutalist hard borders paired with soft pastels.

color_system.strategy: Soft Pastels + Hard Contrast. Deep charcoal text over butter yellow, pale mint, or peach backgrounds.
rules: Avoid standard soft shadows. Use hard offset shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,15,15,1)].
Never use Teal or Purple for CTAs.
In light mode, borders on interactive elements should be 2px solid #0F0F0F.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' strategy. High weight contrast. Massive black headings with clean readable body.

scale_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-text_primary_light

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mobile-First Neo-Brutalism. Clear grid boundaries, generous inner padding.
rules: Mobile screen containers MUST have horizontal padding of p-6.
Card internal padding must be minimum p-6 to avoid text colliding with the hard 2px borders.
Horizontal scroll lists (16 AI Tools) must have massive gaps (gap-4) and horizontal scroll snapping.

surface_strategies.bottom_sheets: Solid #FFFFFF background, rounded-t-3xl, top border is 2px solid #0F0F0F. Drag handle is a solid black pill.
surface_strategies.suggestion_cards: Solid #FFFFFF with 2px border-black and shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,15,15,1)]. Diff views use strong mint/rose background spans.
surface_strategies.ai_tools_toolbar: Flat background for the container. Chips: rounded-xl, border-2 border-black, bg-surface_light, hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(15,15,15,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all.

components.onboarding: Full viewport height. Swipeable slides. Large expressive typography. Backgrounds use the provided image URLs.
components.auth_and_setup: Cards with hard borders. Language/Theme selectors use Shadcn Select but customized with bold text and 2px borders.
components.ai_writing_tools: Horizontal flex list. 16 tools represented as bold, tactile chips.
components.grammar_diff_view: Grammarly style inline cards but Neo-Brutalist. Apply (solid black bg, white text), Dismiss (white bg, black border).
components.chatbot_panel: Control Room grid structure. Bubbles have border-2 border-black. User bubble bg-accent_secondary, AI bubble bg-white.
components.pricing_screen: Cards with massive typography. 'Premium' plan card uses bg-accent_primary, border-4 border-black, and a glowing Tracing Beam or harsh offset shadow.

rules: Active/Press state: shadow-[0px_0px_0px_0px_rgba(15,15,15,1)] translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] (physical button press effect).
AI text generation should look like a terminal typewriter.

icons.style: Stroke width 2.5 or 3.0 to match the bold Neo-Brutalist borders.

onboarding_bg_2.usage: AI features slide background in onboarding.

pricing_hero.usage: Use in the pricing screen for the premium plan illustration.

user_typing.usage: Onboarding slide demonstrating the mobile writing experience.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use React + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI components. Ensure all components are written in .js (JSX), NOT .tsx.

CRITICAL: The environment is 'mobile_web_app'. Build responsive web but wrap the main app layout in a mobile constraint (max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl border-x-2 border-black bg-background_light) so it looks like a mobile app on desktop.
CRITICAL: Apply the Neo-Brutalist twist: heavy use of border-2 border-black, bold offset shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0F0F0F]), and high-contrast typography.
CRITICAL: Import Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi fonts via Fontshare CDN in the global CSS. Do NOT use Inter.
CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, chips).
CRITICAL: The 16 AI Tools must be implemented as a horizontally scrollable container with draggable chips.
CRITICAL: For grammar diffs, highlight removed text with bg-diff_deletion_bg + line-through, and added text with bg-diff_addition_bg. Do NOT use generic red/green without contrast checking.
CRITICAL: Only use the images provided in the image_urls block. No placeholders allowed.
